about_the_game:
Ling Tong "is a new Chinese style horror suspense puzzle game that combines click to solve puzzles and plot exploration.

Can worshipping a spirit child really help you achieve your long cherished wish and make your dreams come true?

The female protagonist Anxi and a group of friends accidentally bumped into a ghost while staying at the Tianfu Village dormitory. After checking in, the homestay owner's instructions, the crying of a child in the middle of the night, and the unexpected encounter with the person next door who was hanged at the toilet door. What kind of story is hidden behind all this mystery?

This is a 'ghost story' adapted from several real reported cases!

Is it a human or a ghost? Please judge!

The development of the story is interconnected, and you can only uncover the truth at the very last moment, which is chilling!

剧情背景

  • The female protagonist Anxi, along with a group of four friends, arrived at a famous tourist village: Tianfu Village.

  • After checking into the homestay, a series of strange things happened: a strange homestay owner, mysterious conversations on the phone, children crying and laughing everywhere, and the person next door hanging from the beam of the house ...

  • Is it a movie or a real plot?

  • What is the purpose of Anxi, who is deeply embroiled in the scandal of accompanying guests, entering Tianfu Village?

  • Step by step, whether the path ahead is the pursuit of ideals or the abyss of human nature ..

  • The movie features an exploratory puzzle solving gameplay with a variety of unique puzzle forms, combined with Chinese culture such as Bagua and Feng Shui, which opens up a lot of imagination!

  • A design that is not difficult but challenging, exploring decryption in a thrilling atmosphere, and understanding the truth of the event during the decryption process.

  • Some mysterious gameplay in the underworld, gain a sense of achievement in the cool and refreshing experience!

  • Homestay murder case, Guanyin shedding blood and tears, female celebrity raising little ghosts, eerie evil children, elementary school students falling victim to collective evil, hair salon family of four tragedy

  • Under the created atmosphere of horror and suspense, the development of the story is interconnected

  • The curtain of truth was not drawn until the very last moment.

  • The nostalgic Chinese animation style, like playing games in childhood cartoons, exudes a local atmosphere.

  • No face to face killing, experience the eerie and thrilling gaming experience in gameplay and atmosphere.

  • The memories of the 1990s, the summer when watching Hong Kong horror movies, the creaking sound of elevators coming from old residential buildings.

  • Each character has their own story and emotions, and when they choose their own path, the ending is already predetermined.

  • Seeking to change one's destiny in vain Will they still be fooled by fate?

  • Fear spreads throughout everyone from the beginning, and the heart is the key to the outcome.
